verses.text: Then Abimelech, and Phicol, the chief captain of his hosts, rose up, and they planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord; and they returned unto the land of the Philistines.
And Abraham worshiped the everlasting God, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.

title: JST, Genesis 21:31–32. Compare Genesis 21:32–34 Abraham worships the everlasting God.
